title: The Landfall of the Coral Triangle
premise: Quentin Oyelaran, a storm chaser drowning in debt to the Voss Syndicate, takes a dying prospector's map to a wreck in the Coral Triangle in exchange for a promise: bring the expedition home and tell no one what it found. But her crew of misfits becomes the family she never had, and the wreck holds evidence that could topple the syndicate itself. When the Voss come to collect, Quentin must choose between paying her debt with the find or protecting her people. She burns the map, scuttles the evidence at sea, and buys her crew's freedom with her own surrender—only for them to refuse to let her go, staging a rescue that leaves the syndicate broken and Quentin, finally, anchored.
about_author: Cyrus Zhou is a former maritime surveyor who spent six years charting reefs from Darwin to Dili before turning to fiction full-time. His novels blend nautical precision with restless, weather-worn characters searching for solid ground.

chapters.title: Miles, Not Years
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. Chasing a supercell across the Gulf of Carpentaria, she calculates distances to avoid calculating time. A collection notice from the Voss Syndicate reminds her what she owes. Emotional beat: the loneliness of a life built on constant motion.

chapters.title: The Optimists
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. A tense meeting with Voss lieutenant Mara Iles, who smiles while doubling Quentin's deadline. Quentin realizes 'dangerous optimists' means men who believe everything works out—for them. Beat: dread disguised as charm.

chapters.title: A Map for a Promise
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. In a Broome hospice, dying prospector Edda Kwan trades Quentin a waterproofed chart to a wreck in the Coral Triangle for one promise: bring whoever sails it home alive, tell no one what they find. Beat: a bargain made in grief.

chapters.title: Assembling the Impossible
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. She recruits a crew on credit and charisma: engineer Tomas Reyes, diver Priya Nair, cook-navigator Old Sef, and runaway deckhand Junie. Each owes someone too. Beat: cautious hope among fellow runaways.

chapters.title: Departure in Bad Weather
chapters.summary: Old Sef's POV. The trawler Corvus leaves Darwin ahead of a cyclone warning because waiting costs money they don't have. Sef reads the sky and says nothing. Beat: the first choice between safety and survival.

chapters.title: The Crossing
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Days of open water forge awkward rituals—shared watches, card games, Junie's nightmares. Priya maps the crew like she maps reefs. Beat: strangers becoming something like a crew.

chapters.title: First Landfall
chapters.summary: Junie's POV. Landfall on an unnamed atoll; Junie, who fled an abusive uncle, learns the crew won't report her absence. First dive reveals the wreck is real—and guarded by modern anchors. Beat: wonder shadowed by suspicion.

chapters.title: What the Wreck Keeps
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. The hold yields ledgers implicating the Voss Syndicate in decades of sinkings-for-insurance, including the ship that killed Edda's family. Tomas, an ex-Voss accountant, recognizes the handwriting. Beat: the promise begins to weigh.

chapters.title: The Radio Call
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. A Voss patrol boat hails them under pretense of customs inspection. Quentin lies smoothly and hates how easily it comes. She orders the evidence hidden but can't make herself destroy it. Beat: duty to the dead versus duty to the living.

chapters.title: Storm Season
chapters.summary: Old Sef's POV. A category-four cyclone traps the Corvus behind the reef. Sef's seamanship saves them, but the mast goes and Junie nearly drowns; Quentin pulls her out. Beat: found family forged in salt and terror.

chapters.title: Repair and Reckoning
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Stranded for repairs, the crew debates what the ledgers mean. Priya confronts Quentin about the promise: whose silence are they keeping? Beat: trust cracking under honest questions.

chapters.title: Edda's Letters
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. Among the papers, letters reveal Edda spent thirty years buying this expedition with her savings, wanting the truth surfaced—not buried. Quentin's promise now contradicts its maker's wish. Beat: guilt reframed as inheritance.

chapters.title: The Patrol Returns
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. The patrol boat returns with boarding rights and Mara Iles aboard. Tomas hides the ledgers inside the ballast, betraying his old employers' methods to beat them. Beat: quiet defiance.

chapters.title: Bargaining at Gunpoint
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. Mara offers to erase the debt if Quentin hands over the find and the crew disperses. Quentin refuses—the first time she's chosen people over survival. Beat: love against duty, stated aloud.

chapters.title: Flight Through the Strait
chapters.summary: Junie's POV. A night escape through uncharted shoals, Junie navigating by memory of her uncle's fishing charts. They scrape through as the patrol grounds itself. Beat: the least likely member saves everyone.

chapters.title: The Price of Survival
chapters.summary: Old Sef's POV. Fuel gone, Sef proposes scuttling the Corvus and the evidence together—ending his forty years afloat. The crew votes; Quentin casts the deciding yes with tears. Beat: sacrifice as anchor.

chapters.title: Landfall of the Coral Triangle
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. They beach the burning Corvus on a triangle of coral and watch the ledgers dissolve in the hold. What they found stays theirs alone—a story without proof. Beat: grief and release entwined.

chapters.title: Debt Collectors
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. Mara waits ashore with enforcers. Quentin offers herself in payment; Mara accepts, planning to make an example. Beat: surrender as the bravest act.

chapters.title: What the Crew Owes
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The crew refuses the terms. Using Tomas's knowledge of Voss accounts and Junie's stolen ledger copies, they trigger an audit that freezes the syndicate mid-transfer. Beat: the powerless striking back.

chapters.title: The Rescue
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV. A chaotic dockside extraction: Sef's distraction, Priya's diving trickery, Junie cutting lines. They pull Quentin off Mara's yacht as the audit lands. Beat: family refusing to abandon its own.

chapters.title: Anchored
chapters.summary: Quentin's POV. Debt voided, syndicate collapsing, Quentin stands on shore with no miles left to run. She opens Edda's last letter: 'Home is whoever you bring back.' Beat: stillness after a lifetime of motion.

chapters.title: The Next Chart
chapters.summary: Full-crew POV rotation. Months later, the crew refits a new vessel—not to flee, but to finish Edda's survey honestly, names logged openly. Quentin draws the first course line. Beat: survival transformed into purpose.
